panels.title: ${metric} in every room and yard, hourly
panels.description: The household's own sensors, hourly means of the raw readings. A silence of three hours or more breaks the line.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.ts, '1h'), coalesce(nullif(s.room, ''), nullif(s.name, ''), s.sensor_id) AS metric, avg(r.value) AS value
FROM readings r JOIN sensors s USING (sensor_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.ts <= now() AND r.metric = '${metric}' AND s.local AND s.kind = 'sensor'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ${metric} in ${indoor} by hour of day, one column per day
panels.description: Each cell is that hour's mean in the node's own timezone. A habit shows as a row, a bad day as a column.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', r.ts AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone')) AS d,
         extract(hour FROM r.ts AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone'))::int AS h, r.value AS value
  FROM readings r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.ts <= now() AND r.metric = '${metric}' AND r.sensor_id = '${indoor}')
SELECT d AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TimeZone') AS time,
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 0) AS "0",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 1) AS "1",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 2) AS "2",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 3) AS "3",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 4) AS "4",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 5) AS "5",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 6) AS "6",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 7) AS "7",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 8) AS "8",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 9) AS "9",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 10) AS "10",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 11) AS "11",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 12) AS "12",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 13) AS "13",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 14) AS "14",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 15) AS "15",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 16) AS "16",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 17) AS "17",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 18) AS "18",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 19) AS "19",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 20) AS "20",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 21) AS "21",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 22) AS "22",
avg(value) FILTER (WHERE h = 23) AS "23"
FROM b GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

panels.title: ${indoor} against ${outdoor}, hourly means
panels.description: One dot per hour. Above the diagonal the room is worse than outside: the source is indoors.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', r.ts) AS hr, r.sensor_id, avg(r.value) AS v FROM readings r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.ts <= now() AND r.metric = '${metric}' AND r.sensor_id IN ('${indoor}', '${outdoor}')
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT o.v AS outdoor, i.v AS indoor
FROM h i JOIN h o ON o.hr = i.hr AND o.sensor_id = '${outdoor}' WHERE i.sensor_id = '${indoor}'

panels.title: When each sensor was heard (readings per 3 h, red = silent)
panels.description: Every sensor of the household's, every three hours, the ones that have gone quiet included. A sensor that never spoke is a red row.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sn AS (SELECT sensor_id, coalesce(nullif(s.room, ''), nullif(s.name, ''), s.sensor_id) AS label FROM sensors s WHERE s.local AND s.kind = 'sensor'),
tb AS (SELECT generate_series(to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) / 10800) * 10800),
                              least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()), interval '3 hours') AS b),
c AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM r.ts) / 10800) * 10800) AS b, r.sensor_id, count(*) AS n
      FROM readings r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.ts <= now() GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT tb.b AS time, sn.label AS metric, coalesce(c.n, 0) AS value
FROM tb CROSS JOIN sn LEFT JOIN c ON c.b = tb.b AND c.sensor_id = sn.sensor_id ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Outside: every station the node reads, and the model
panels.description: Hourly means of every outdoor sensor, the neighbours' included, and the model where there is one (dashed). Click a name to isolate it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.ts, '1h'), coalesce(nullif(s.room, ''), nullif(s.name, ''), s.sensor_id) AS metric, avg(r.value) AS value
FROM readings r JOIN sensors s USING (sensor_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.ts <= now() AND s.indoor IS NOT TRUE
  AND ((s.kind = 'sensor' AND r.metric = '${metric}') OR (s.kind = 'model' AND r.metric = '${metric}_model'))
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Radios: how busy the LoRa channel is
panels.description: Airtime and channel use each Meshtastic radio reports. Empty on a node with no radio.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.ts, $__interval), coalesce(nullif(s.room, ''), nullif(s.name, ''), s.sensor_id) || ' ' || r.metric AS metric, avg(r.value) AS value
FROM readings r JOIN sensors s USING (sensor_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.ts <= now() AND r.metric IN ('lora_util_pct', 'lora_channel_pct')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
